operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: how Store OS works, the rules, the row formats for bringing in orders, conversations and products, and the recipe for every kind of task.

operations.name: app.status
operations.description: Where the store stands: set up or not, the shops (with their sync and setup state), what needs attention (orders to ship and late, messages due, approvals, listing issues, low stock, missing costs) and your open tasks.

operations.name: app.convert
operations.description: Convert an amount between currencies at the store's exchange rates (to price a listing in a shop's currency).

from.description: Its currency, e.g. MYR (default: the base currency)

operations.name: app.home
operations.description: Everything the Home page shows (about 14 KB): settings, shops, attention counts, the sales report with its daily series, recent orders and activity. To answer the seller, reports.overview (figures) and reports.attention (what needs them, late orders named) are a quarter of the size.

operations.name: app.search
operations.description: Search orders (number, buyer), products (title, SKU, barcode), customers and conversations at once.

operations.name: app.export
operations.description: Everything in the store as one JSON document (shops, catalog, stock ledger, orders, customers, conversations, proposals).

operations.name: platforms.list
operations.description: The platforms a shop can be on (id, kind, countries, title limit (0: no fixed limit known, not checked), seller sign-up and seller centre links), the countries and the currencies.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: The business, base currency, country, time zone, your AI agent's limits (autonomy), guards, buyer-data period, low-stock default and exchange rates.

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change the business details and rules. The base currency cannot change once products have prices.

base_currency.description: Currency of product prices, costs and reports, e.g. MYR

utc_offset.description: Minutes east of UTC in the seller's time zone (Malaysia 480); reports count days by it. The app keeps it equal to timezone, so set timezone instead.

pii_days.description: Days to keep buyer addresses and phone numbers after an order is finished (7 to 3650)

max_price_drop_pct.description: A proposed price drop larger than this percentage is marked high risk

min_margin_pct.description: Margin below which prices are flagged

onboarded.description: The seller finished the first-run setup

operations.name: settings.autonomy
operations.description: What your AI agent may change without asking: ask (it proposes, the seller approves) or auto, per kind of change. [The seller only.]

operations.name: settings.fx-refresh
operations.description: Fetch today's exchange rates against the base currency now (they also refresh every six hours).

operations.name: activity.list
operations.description: Who changed what, newest first.

target.description: Only this target, e.g. order:<id>, shop:<id>, product:<id>

operations.name: shops.list
operations.description: Every shop with its platform, currency, status, connection, setup progress, last sync, orders to ship, open conversations, live listings and any task your AI agent is on.

operations.name: shops.get
operations.description: One shop: everything in shops.list plus its setup checklist (steps with links), fee rates, ship-by days, reply hours, stock rule, policies, recent imports and tasks.

operations.name: shops.add
operations.description: Add a shop you have, or start opening a new one (opening=true starts its setup checklist). Two shops on one platform are two shops with their own names.

opening.description: true when the shop is not open yet (shows the setup checklist)

region.description: Country code the shop sells in, e.g. MY

currency.description: Currency of the shop's prices and orders, e.g. MYR

admin_url.description: The shop's seller centre or admin link

connection.description: How its data comes in: agent (your AI agent syncs it), files (seller-centre exports), manual

operations.name: shops.update
operations.description: Change a shop: details, status, connection, fee rates (used to estimate profit until real fees arrive), days to ship, reply hours and the stock rule.

commission_pct.description: Commission the platform takes on items, in percent

payment_pct.description: Payment or transaction fee on the order total, in percent

fixed_fee.description: Fixed fee per order, in the shop's currency

ship_days.description: Days from order to hand-over (the ship-by clock)

reply_hours.description: Hours to answer a buyer (the reply clock)

stock_share.description: Percent of available stock the shop shows (0 to 100)

stock_buffer.description: Units held back from this shop

stock_max.description: Most units the shop shows (0: no limit)

region.description: Country code the shop sells in, e.g. MY

currency.description: Currency of the shop's prices and orders, e.g. MYR

admin_url.description: The shop's seller centre or admin link

connection.description: How its data comes in: agent (your AI agent syncs it), files (seller-centre exports), manual

operations.name: shops.policies
operations.description: Write the shop's return, shipping and FAQ text and the reply voice; your AI agent quotes them when it answers buyers.

voice.description: How replies should sound, e.g. "friendly, short, sign as Aina"

operations.name: shops.step
operations.description: Tick (or untick) a step of the shop's setup checklist. When every step is done, a shop being opened becomes active.

operations.name: shops.remove
operations.description: Delete a shop with its orders, listings and conversations. The Direct shop stays. [The seller only.]

operations.name: shops.sync
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to bring in the shop's new orders, buyer messages and listings (a sync task).

operations.name: shops.help
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to help with one setup step of a shop (a setup_help task).

note.description: Anything the seller wants it to know

operations.name: shops.sync-finish
operations.description: Your AI agent: record that a sync ended (sets the last sync time unless failed) and finish the sync task.

note.description: What came in, e.g. "12 new orders, 3 updated, 4 messages"

failed.description: true when the sync could not be done

operations.name: products.list
operations.description: The catalog: each product with its SKUs, price range (base currency), available stock, stock state, missing costs and its listing status on every shop (with blocking issues). counts gives the totals per filter.

q.description: Search title, brand, category, SKU or barcode

shop.description: Only products listed on this shop

operations.name: products.get
operations.description: One product: facts (with where each came from), pictures (image_paths on this machine for your AI agent), SKUs with price, cost and stock (on hand, reserved, available), every listing with its pre-flight issues, the shops it is not on, units sold in 30 days and tasks.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

operations.name: products.add
operations.description: Add a product with its first SKU (a SKU is made when none is given). Prices and costs are in the base currency; stock is the opening count.

operations.name: products.create
operations.description: Create a whole product at once: details, organisation, facts, every SKU with its price, cost and opening stock (base currency), and a draft listing on each chosen shop. Checked first, so a bad field creates nothing. Add pictures after with products.add-images.

variants.description: JSON list of SKUs: [{"option":"Blue / 350 ml","sku":"MUG-BLU","price":29,"cost":9,"stock":40,"barcode":"","weight_g":350,"low_stock":5}] (one entry for a product without options; a SKU is made when sku is empty)

shops.description: JSON list of shops (ids or names) to start a draft listing on

operations.name: products.update
operations.description: Change a product's title, brand, category, description, status, note or tags (the catalog copy; each shop's listing has its own text).

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

operations.name: products.facts
operations.description: Set product facts (material, size, care...) with where each came from; an empty value removes a fact.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

facts.description: JSON object, e.g. {"material":{"value":"stoneware","source":"photo"}} (source: you, agent, photo, supplier, web, import)

operations.name: products.add-images
operations.description: Add pictures to a product (up to 12). Screens upload them; your AI agent gives --paths.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

paths.description: Your AI agent: JSON list of absolute file paths, e.g. ["C:/photos/mug.jpg"]

operations.name: products.remove-image
operations.description: Remove one picture.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

name.description: Picture file name from products.get images

operations.name: products.cover
operations.description: Make a picture the first (cover) picture.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

operations.name: products.remove
operations.description: Delete a product with its SKUs, stock ledger and listings (past orders keep their lines).

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

confirm.description: Your AI agent: true once the seller asked for this deletion. Without it nothing is deleted and the answer says what would be.

operations.name: products.upsert-many
operations.description: Create or update products from rows (a product export or your AI agent's sync), matched on SKU. Rows sharing "group" become SKUs of one product. With --shop the listing on that shop is recorded too. Row format: app.guide rows.product.

shop.description: The shop these rows come from

stock_mode.description: new_only (default: stock counts only for new SKUs) | set (count every SKU to the given stock) | ignore

operations.name: products.prepare
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to write listings of a product for some shops (a prepare_listing task; its drafts come back through Approvals).

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

shops.description: JSON list of shops (ids or names); default every active shop

note.description: What the seller wants, e.g. "stress gift-giving"

operations.name: variants.add
operations.description: Add a SKU to a product.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

operations.name: variants.update
operations.description: Change a SKU's code, option, cost, barcode, weight or low-stock level (prices change with variants.set-price). A new cost fills in orders that sold without one.

operations.name: variants.set-price
operations.description: Change a SKU's selling price (base currency). [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set prices changes to automatic.]

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: variants.remove
operations.description: Delete a SKU and its stock ledger (past orders keep their lines).

confirm.description: Your AI agent: true once the seller asked for this deletion. Without it nothing is deleted and the answer says what would be.

operations.name: listings.draft
operations.description: Write or change a product's listing on one shop: title, description, price in the shop's currency, keywords, and draft or ready. A live listing stays live and shows that its changes still need publishing. [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set listings changes to automatic.]

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: listings.link
operations.description: Record that a product is on a shop (found while syncing or importing): its id there, link, status, price and the stock it shows now.

product.description: The product (id, exact title or one of its SKUs)

operations.name: listings.status
operations.description: Set a listing's status: live after it was published (with its id and link), paused, ready or draft. Name it by --listing, or --product and --shop.

operations.name: listings.remove
operations.description: Remove a listing from Store OS (it is not taken off the platform).

confirm.description: Your AI agent: true once the seller asked for this deletion. Without it nothing is deleted and the answer says what would be.

operations.name: listings.publish
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to publish listings on a shop (default: every ready listing and every live one with unpublished changes).

listings.description: JSON list of listing ids (default: all that are due)

operations.name: stock.overview
operations.description: Every SKU with on hand, reserved (open orders), available, low-stock level, state (ok, low, out), unit cost and stock value; totals.

q.description: Search SKU, option, title or barcode

operations.name: stock.moves
operations.description: A SKU's stock ledger: every move with its reason, reference, who made it and the balance after.

operations.name: stock.adjust
operations.description: Add or take away stock: +24 received, -2 damaged. [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set stock changes to automatic.]

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: stock.count
operations.description: Set on hand to what you counted on the shelf (the ledger records the difference). [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set stock changes to automatic.]

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: stock.plan
operations.description: What each shop should show and does not yet: per live listing and SKU, the quantity (qty) from what is available and the shop's stock rule, and the last quantity set there (last, null when unknown); shop_count is how many shops need changes.

sku.description: Only the product of this SKU

operations.name: stock.mark-pushed
operations.description: Record the quantities shops now show (after they were set on the platform), one call for any number of shops: items like [{"shop":"Shopee MY","sku":"MUG-BLU","qty":12}], or --all true with --shop (every stock.plan row of that shop) and/or --sku (that product on every shop).

shop.description: The shop for items that name none, and for --all (id or name)

all.description: true: every stock.plan row for --shop and/or --sku, at its qty

sku.description: With --all: only the product of this SKU

operations.name: stock.push
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to set the stock on a shop to stock.plan's numbers (a push_stock task).

operations.name: orders.list
operations.description: Orders across shops by view: to_ship (default, by ship-by), unpaid, at_risk (late or due within a day), shipped, exceptions (tracking problem or no update for 7 days), delivered, returns, cancelled, unlinked (a line whose SKU is not in the catalog), all. counts gives each view's size. Each row has the shop, buyer, items, total, status, ship-by, hours left, health and tracking.

view.description: to_ship | unpaid | at_risk | shipped | exceptions | delivered | returns | cancelled | unlinked | all

q.description: Order number, buyer name, email or phone

operations.name: orders.get
operations.description: One order: lines (with SKU links), buyer and address, money (fees, shipping cost, cost of goods, profit and margin in the base currency), shipments with tracking events, conversations, a timeline and tasks.

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

operations.name: orders.add
operations.description: Add an order by hand (the Direct shop by default: chat, social and in-person sales). Lines take a SKU (its price is used when none is given) or a title.

number.description: Order number (Direct orders are numbered D1001, D1002...)

fees.description: Platform or payment fees, when known

ship_by.description: Ship by (default: placed + the shop's days to ship)

operations.name: orders.upsert-many
operations.description: Bring in a shop's orders (your AI agent's sync): created or updated by order number, so repeating is safe. Status only moves forward. Orders that arrive already shipped do not move stock. Row format: app.guide rows.order.

items.description: JSON list of order rows (up to 2000)

operations.name: orders.ship
operations.description: Mark an order shipped (its items leave the shelf) with the carrier and tracking number.

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

operations.name: orders.ship-many
operations.description: Mark many orders shipped at once.

operations.name: orders.deliver
operations.description: Mark an order delivered.

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

operations.name: orders.cancel
operations.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped (its reserved items go back to available). Cancel it on the platform too; a paid order needs its refund recorded with orders.refund. [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set orders changes to automatic.]

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

reason.description: The cancel reason stored on the order, e.g. "buyer changed their mind"

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: orders.refund
operations.description: Record a refund on an order (in the order's currency); the money itself is returned on the platform. [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set orders changes to automatic.]

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: orders.return
operations.description: Record items coming back (all lines when none are given); restock=true puts them back in stock. [Becomes a proposal the seller approves, unless the seller set orders changes to automatic.]

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

restock.description: Put the items back in stock

why.description: Your AI agent: one or two lines on why, shown to the seller with the proposal.

operations.name: orders.update
operations.description: Change an order's buyer details, address, note, ship-by, payment, what the buyer was charged (shipping, discount, tax: the total follows), fees ("" goes back to estimated) or your shipping cost; status only between unpaid and to_ship.

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

shipping.description: Shipping charged to the buyer (order currency)

discount.description: Discount given to the buyer (order currency)

tax.description: Tax charged to the buyer (order currency)

fees.description: Fees the platform charged (major units), or "" to estimate them

operations.name: orders.link-line
operations.description: Link an order line whose SKU is not in the catalog to one of your SKUs (other lines with the same SKU text are linked too).

operations.name: orders.line-extra
operations.description: Mark an order line as not a product (a gift card, gift wrap, a service fee): it moves no stock, takes the cost you give (0 when it costs nothing) and stops counting as an unknown SKU. Store OS remembers it by SKU (else title) for later orders.

cost.description: What it costs you per unit, in the base currency (default 0)

all.description: false: only this line (default: every line with the same SKU or title)

operations.name: orders.remove
operations.description: Delete an order (stock moves already made stay in the ledger). [The seller only.]

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

operations.name: orders.help
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to check an order's tracking (task tracking) or sort out a delivery problem (task exception).

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

operations.name: orders.track-all
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to check the tracking of every parcel on its way.

operations.name: shipments.update
operations.description: Record tracking: status, the latest event and its time, carrier, number, link, estimated delivery. A delivered status marks the order delivered. Name the shipment, or the order (its latest shipment).

shop.description: The shop, when two shops share an order number

status.description: pending | info_received | in_transit | out_for_delivery | available_for_pickup | delivered | failed_attempt | exception | returned

event.description: The latest event as the carrier words it

operations.name: inbox.list
operations.description: Conversations by view: due (open, soonest reply deadline first), to_draft (due with no draft yet), drafted (a reply waits for the seller), waiting (answered, waiting on the buyer), open, closed, all. Each row: shop, buyer, order, subject, last message, hours left, intent, draft and task.

view.description: due | to_draft | drafted | waiting | open | closed | all

q.description: Search subject, buyer, text or order number

operations.name: inbox.get
operations.description: One conversation: messages (in, out, private notes), the draft with its reasons and warnings, the buyer, the linked order (status, tracking), the buyer's other orders and the shop's policies and seller centre.

operations.name: inbox.add
operations.description: Log a buyer message (one that came by email, chat or phone): starts a conversation, or adds to --thread.

channel.description: chat | email | whatsapp | phone | social | other

intent.description: where_is_order | return | refund | cancel | change_address | product_question | complaint | other

direction.description: in (from the buyer, default) | out (a reply already sent)

operations.name: inbox.add-many
operations.description: Bring in a shop's conversations (your AI agent's sync), matched on the platform's conversation and message ids so repeating adds nothing twice. Row format: app.guide rows.conversation.

operations.name: inbox.draft
operations.description: Write the reply draft of a conversation, with why (the facts and policy used). The seller reads, edits and sends it. Finishes a draft_reply task.

why.description: What it is based on: order status, tracking, policy

intent.description: where_is_order | return | refund | cancel | change_address | product_question | complaint | other

operations.name: inbox.reply
operations.description: The seller sends a reply: copied (pasted into the seller centre, recorded as sent), manual (sent some other way) or agent (your AI agent sends it: a send_reply task). [The seller only.]

operations.name: inbox.sent
operations.description: Your AI agent: confirm it sent a reply the seller handed it (--message), or, only when replies are set to automatic, record a reply it sent (--thread --text).

operations.name: inbox.send-failed
operations.description: Your AI agent: a reply could not be sent (the conversation reopens for the seller).

operations.name: inbox.note
operations.description: Add a private note to a conversation (never sent).

operations.name: inbox.update
operations.description: Change a conversation's status (open, waiting, closed), intent, subject or linked order.

order.description: Order number or id ("" to unlink)

operations.name: inbox.ask-draft
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to draft a reply (a draft_reply task).

operations.name: inbox.ask-draft-all
operations.description: Ask your AI agent to draft replies for every open conversation without a draft.

operations.name: customers.list
operations.description: Buyers across shops with their order count, total spent (base currency) and last order; repeat buyers with filter=repeat.

operations.name: customers.get
operations.description: One buyer: details, every order on every shop, and conversations.

operations.name: customers.update
operations.description: Change a buyer's name, email, phone, private note or tags.

operations.name: proposals.list
operations.description: Proposals waiting for the seller (pending, oldest first) or decided ones: each with its items (what changes, before and after), risk and notes.

operations.name: proposals.get
operations.description: One proposal with its items and their states (pending, applied, stale, failed, rejected, undone).

operations.name: proposals.create
operations.description: Your AI agent: propose several changes as one set for the seller to approve at once. Each item is an operation that needs approval (listings.draft, variants.set-price, stock.adjust, stock.count, orders.cancel, orders.refund, orders.return) with its params.

title.description: What the set does, e.g. "Listings for the blue mug on 3 shops"

why.description: One or two lines on why

operations.name: proposals.approve
operations.description: Apply a proposal (all items, or the chosen ones; the rest are rejected). Each item is checked again first and skipped as stale if what it changes moved. [The seller only.]

items.description: JSON list of item indexes to apply (default all)

operations.name: proposals.reject
operations.description: Reject a proposal, with a note for your AI agent. [The seller only.]

note.description: Why, so your AI agent does better next time

operations.name: proposals.undo
operations.description: Put back what an applied proposal changed (listing text and price, SKU prices, stock). Order actions cannot be undone. [The seller only.]

operations.name: proposals.withdraw
operations.description: Withdraw a pending proposal (it no longer applies).

operations.name: tasks.list
operations.description: Your AI agent's tasks: open ones by default (queued, asked, working), oldest first. Each has a kind (sync, publish, push_stock, setup_help, prepare_listing, draft_reply, send_reply, tracking, exception, chat), a target, a label and params; app.guide has the recipe for each kind.

state.description: queued | asked | working | done | failed | cancelled | all (default: the open ones)

operations.name: tasks.recent
operations.description: The latest tasks of any state, newest first (what the seller asked for and what came of it).

operations.name: tasks.get
operations.description: One task.

operations.name: tasks.start
operations.description: Your AI agent: mark a task as being worked on (the seller sees it).

operations.name: tasks.finish
operations.description: Your AI agent: finish a task with a one-line note the seller reads (or --failed true with why).

note.description: What was done, or why not

failed.description: true when it could not be done

operations.name: tasks.cancel
operations.description: Cancel an open task.

operations.name: chats.list
operations.description: What the seller told your AI agent in the app and its replies, oldest first.

operations.name: chats.send
operations.description: The seller tells your AI agent something (a chat task). [The seller only.]

context.description: Where the seller was, e.g. order:<id>

operations.name: chats.reply
operations.description: Your AI agent: answer the seller's message (finishes its chat task).

operations.name: reports.overview
operations.description: Sales across shops in the base currency, days counted in the seller's time zone: net sales, profit, orders, average order, margin and refunds, each with delta_pct (change against the previous period); a series by day (by month for 12m) with the previous period alongside; each shop (delta_pct: change in net sales) with its sparkline; best-selling products; quality (orders missing a cost, orders with no shipping cost of yours) and fees_estimated_share.

operations.name: reports.attention
operations.description: What needs the seller now, as counts: orders to ship, late (late_orders names the oldest five), due soon, unpaid, delivery exceptions, messages open and overdue, drafts ready, approvals, listing issues, low and out of stock, missing costs, unlinked SKUs, stock to set on shops, open tasks.

operations.name: reports.profit
operations.description: Profit and loss for a period (base currency, the seller's days): items, discount, shipping_charged, refunds, net_sales (items - discount + shipping charged - refunds), fees, ship_cost (yours), cogs, profit and margin, in total and per shop; estimates says how much is estimated (fees from rates, orders missing a cost, orders with no shipping cost).

operations.name: imports.orders
operations.description: Import a shop's order export: rows already matched to Store OS fields (app.guide rows.order). Matched on order number, so importing the same file twice changes nothing; the import is kept with its results.

operations.name: imports.products
operations.description: Import a product list (app.guide rows.product), matched on SKU; with --shop the listings on that shop are recorded too.

shop.description: The shop the export comes from

operations.name: imports.list
operations.description: Past imports with what each created, updated and skipped, and why.
